title: Accelerated Prox-Level Methods for Unknown Piecewise-Smooth Optimization I: Convex Optimization
summary: We introduce a nearly parameter-free algorithm for minimizing piecewise smooth (PWS) convex functions under the quadratic-growth (QG) condition, where the locations and structure of the smooth regions are entirely unknown. Our algorithm, APEX (Accelerated Prox-Level method for Exploring Piecewise Smoothness), is an accelerated bundle-level method designed to adaptively exploit the underlying PWS structure.
